questions.statement: The ________ is the king of the jungle.
questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: The lion is the king of the jungle: he is a top predator and the symbol of the savannah.
Monkeys live in trees and are playful; the lion is the one called the king of the jungle.
Elephants are the largest land animals, but they are not called the king of the jungle.
Giraffes eat leaves from tall trees and are known for their long necks.

questions.explanation:
This question evaluates remember skills regarding wild animals at the CEFR A1 level.

questions.statement: The ________ has a very long neck.
questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: Snakes have no legs and no long neck; that is not their feature.
The giraffe has a very long neck, which lets it reach the leaves high in the trees.
Tigers have short necks and a striped coat.
Zebras have short, upright manes, not long necks.

questions.statement: The ________ is very big and has a trunk.
questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: Monkeys are small and they have hands, not a trunk.
Snakes have no limbs at all, so they cannot have a trunk.
The elephant is very big and has a trunk, the long nose it uses to breathe and drink.
Lions are big cats with manes, but they have no trunk.

questions.statement: A ________ loves to climb trees and eat bananas.
questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: Elephants eat grass and leaves and are too heavy to climb trees.
Giraffes browse on leaves; they are not the animal known for climbing and eating bananas.
Zebras graze grass on the plains; they do not climb trees.
Monkeys climb trees and eat bananas, as the sentence describes.

questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: A zebra is the animal with black and white stripes.
A lion has a plain tawny coat; the orange colour belongs to the tiger.
A tiger is orange with black stripes, so 'tiger' is the answer if you mean the orange animal.
An elephant is grey and has no stripes.

options.feedback: A giraffe has a long neck and a spotted coat; it is not a cat.
A tiger is a big cat with orange fur and black stripes.
A lion is a big cat too, but its coat is plain golden and it has no stripes.
Monkeys are not cats and have no fur like this.

questions.context: Learning about wild animals in English class.

options.feedback: An elephant has four thick legs and walks on them.
A lion has four legs and runs on them.
A snake has no legs and moves by slithering along the ground.
Monkeys have arms and legs and climb with them.

A rabbit is small and shy; it lives in a burrow, not the forest, and it does not seek honey.
A mouse is a tiny rodent that lives in walls and eats grain.
A bear is big and strong, lives in the forest, and loves honey.
